summary: Customer runs a cell culture process in aqueous medium and currently measures glucose and lactate from samples, causing delay. They are exploring an in situ spectroscopy pilot to be checked against existing laboratory measurements. The medium and cell population change during the run, and no probe or calibration strategy has been selected.
